free_text: The 68-year-old male has a PSA of 7.5 and an IPSS score of 30/35, indicating severe LUTS. Biopsy confirmed Gleason 3+3 (ISUP grade group 1). MRI revealed a focal hypointense lesion in the peripheral zone measuring 12 mm with restricted diffusion and early enhancement, but no extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion was noted. Management assessment is active surveillance pending clinical review of treatment benefit and patient preferences.
